help.title: Help
help.explanation.part1: EcoSort simplifies your recycling. Just take a photo of your waste with the
help.explanation.part2: , and our AI will instantly tell you which bin to use. Together, let's optimize sorting!
help.contact.note: Contact us anytime via WhatsApp for immediate assistance.
help.faq1.question: Is the object not recognized?
help.faq1.answer: Check image quality, framing, and lighting. If needed, retry with a sharper photo.
help.faq2.question: Where can I find collection points?
help.faq2.answer: Collection points are available in the dedicated app section, with useful info on locations and accepted waste.
help.faq3.question: Can I use the app without internet?
help.faq3.answer: Offline use may be limited. Some features require a connection for analysis and data syncing.
